# AminoAcidSupplements Chemical Monograph Registry
> British & Global analytical amino acid sequence and synthetic peptide research registry.

## Core Mandate & Compliance
All indexed entities are strictly for academic, educational, and laboratory analytical research in vitro.
Substances are unapproved research chemicals governed under UK Human Medicines Regulations 2012 (SI 2012/1916).

## Key Canonical Endpoints
- Homepage: https://aminoacidsupplements.co/
- Research Blog: https://aminoacidsupplements.co/blog/
- Verified Supplier Audits: https://aminoacidsupplements.co/vendors/
- UK MHRA Tracker: https://aminoacidsupplements.co/regulatory/mhra-tracker/
- Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 Matrix: https://aminoacidsupplements.co/regulatory/uk-legal-status/
- Full Discovery Manifest: https://aminoacidsupplements.co/llms-full.txt
- Machine Sitemap: https://aminoacidsupplements.co/sitemap.xml

## Signaling Pathways (6 Categories)
- [Tissue Repair & Angiogenesis](https://aminoacidsupplements.co/category/tissue-repair-recovery/): UK Laboratory Investigation into Cellular Migration & Microvascular Integrity
- [Neuropeptides & CNS Signaling](https://aminoacidsupplements.co/category/neuropeptides-cognition/): Pre-Clinical Neurotrophic Expression & Central Synaptic Modulation
- [Growth Hormone Secretagogues & GHRH](https://aminoacidsupplements.co/category/growth-hormone-secretagogues/): Anterior Pituitary Somatotroph Receptors & Pulsatile Endocrine Cascades
- [Metabolic & Incretin Signaling](https://aminoacidsupplements.co/category/metabolic-regulation/): Dual Incretin Receptor Co-Agonism & Lipolytic Energy Dynamics
- [Dermal & Extracellular Matrix](https://aminoacidsupplements.co/category/dermal-extracellular-matrix/): Copper Chelation Dynamics & Fibroblast Procollagen Remodeling
- [Cellular Longevity & Mitochondrial Axis](https://aminoacidsupplements.co/category/cellular-longevity-mitochondrial/): Telomeric Chromatin Architecture & Mitochondrial-Derived Bioenergetics
